images.prompt:
Create ONE production concept sheet for version0.6 of the original Japanese 3D comedy game "全力退勤", focusing on ACTION→WORLD REACTION. Reference1 is the current REAL GAME screenshot; reference2 is the approved sleepy brown-haired teal-vest coworker with a cat mug; reference3 is the existing comic VFX/UI style guide. Preserve these exact toy people, chairs, red extinguisher, teal office, cream tiles, CRT desks and warm sunset. This is an implementable Godot Web concept, not a final screenshot. Keep rounded 3D toys with heavy navy/cream/red/gold comic graphics and slight voxel accents only in cubes/small props. No extra characters, weapons, abilities, bloom, blur or photorealism.

Landscape16:9 sheet. Upper two-thirds is ONE large in-game moment, lower third is THREE readable small sequence/pose studies on ivory paper, small heading "操作で、職場がざわつく". Same chunky navy line, clipped paper borders and gold/red/teal palette as reference3. In the upper scene the existing panicked salaryman/chair/red tank is slightly larger than reference1 (about30%ofscreenheight), at center-lower, face and next floor route visible. He crashes through a paper tower: large local asymmetric gold/navy/pink comic impact star BEHIND contact and body, two thin rings, clean curved fan of stamped cream paper sheets thrown mostly in his travel direction, only a few gold cubes. Behind his nozzle show a thick CONNECTED white rounded tapered exhaust cone, tiny at nozzle and widening through scalloped cloud lobes over2–3meters, thin cyan contour and 2rear streaks; cleanly follows his heading, does not hide face. Near LEFT desk a coworker from reference2 has swivelled toward the ACTUAL broken tower, eyes suddenly wide and mouth small open oval, recoils in teal chair and clutches/lifts same cat mug away from flying paper; little "！" / ivory comic callout "マグ死守！" positioned above their own head, below HUD and beside their chair. Another close coworker on right is mid-flinch, one small sweat drop and surprised "紙ィー！" ticket. A distant coworker beyond remains relaxed/sleepy working at their CRT, visibly no reaction balloon. No one is hit or injured. Show legible causal direction via the paper fan and their gaze; no mapwide reactions.

Keep actual v0.5 top-left navy clipped timecard "退勤TIME 00:08.60", top-right serrated cream expense receipt "被害総額 ¥440,000", large yellow "4" with "連鎖×3" ticket, small top-center teal "EXIT ↑87m"; concise upper notice "書類、全提出！" with separate "+¥150,000" ticket. Lower-left illustrated extinguisher+segmented pressure gauge "残圧68%", lower-right keycaps SPACE/←→/R/ESC and small pause tab. Counters stay horizontal. Bigger actors/reactions and VFX should remain readable without burying office route.

Bottom studies with headers1"近くで破壊" 2"大きく破壊" 3"少し離れて":1 same coworker turns, wide-eyed protects cat mug, 0.08s→1.2s reaction then a small return-to-sleep arrow;2 same coworker chair tilts comically5–10degrees with feet safely grounded, mug raised, visible startled eyes and sweat, stronger gold "!!" but no falling ragdoll;3 distant coworker small glance and returns to CRT, no big bounce. Include tiny visual cues "振り向く → マグ死守 → 通常業務" and "近い人だけ・最大2人". Cohesive polished playful design, deliberately achievable lowpoly meshes and local animated pivots, not arbitrary added spectacle.
